summary: Clamps the byte at a1 into the inclusive range [a2, a3]: writes a2 when the value is below the lower bound, writes a3 when it is above the upper bound, and returns the original value.

local_names.a1: pointer to the byte value to clamp

operations.description: result = *a1: read the current byte value
if *a1 < a2 (below lower bound) or *a1 > a3 (above upper bound), the value is out of range

*a1 = a2: write the violated bound; in the decompiled expression a2 is reassigned to a3 by the comma operator when the upper bound is exceeded, so *a1 receives a2 below the low bound and a3 above the high bound
return result: the pre-clamp value of *a1

unresolved: the decompiler comma-operator expression (a2 = a3, result > a3) is a codegen artifact for selecting the violated bound; the two-sided clamp interpretation is recovered from the guard and write
no evidence identifies the object or setting the clamped byte belongs to
